customerDetail.bulkUploadDesc: Excel columns: ticker, type, quantity, date, price. Dates must be dd-mm-yyyy (e.g. 02-07-2024 = 2 July 2024). Type them as text so Excel does not flip day and month. Rows must be sorted by date ascending (oldest first). The first validation error stops the upload — later rows are not processed. Price is checked against that day's high/low unless you use Bypass (not applied to client transfers). Use type CLIENT_TRANSFER with ticker, quantity, date, price to book in-kind shares (no cash). Use type TRANSFER with an amount to withdraw cash (leave ticker/quantity/price blank). Any dividends/bonus issues already on the books for the stocks in this file are automatically applied to this portfolio's cash/holdings after upload.

systemConfig.title: System Config
systemConfig.description: Super Admin only. IPS thresholds, feature flags, Halal tags, official closing prices, and QERI/DSM index history — changes apply immediately to engines.
systemConfig.pricesIntro: Official statement market value uses Postgres stock_prices on the as-of date only. Source table in KB is CB_PRICES (Company-Closing-Prices-By-Ticker.md). SQL trading DB has no price table. Import the KB file, upload CB_PRICES, or add a ticker+date+close here.
systemConfig.pricesEmptyDesc: Import the KB file or add MHAR 2024-12-01 manually.
systemConfig.indicesIntro: Benchmark history for QERI (Al Rayan Islamic) and DSM (QE General Index) comes from KB CH_CURRENT_INDEX. Sector series in that file are skipped. QERI rows in the dump start 2026-06-21.
systemConfig.flagsIntro: If / then switches. Example: turn on hard block for illiquid names → eligibility fails those stocks.
systemConfig.halalIntro: Mark equities as Shariah (حلال) or Not Shariah. Fully Shariah mandates may hold Shariah names only. You can also set Approved List status and illiquid here.

source.portfolioValue: Open-lot equity (shares × close) plus cash from the client account summary, as of the selected date.
source.portfolioGrowth: Workbook growth: (equity including cash) ÷ (total cost including cash) − 1.
source.indexPerformance: Mandate benchmark level return from first funding/trade date to as-of: as-of level ÷ start level − 1.
source.portfolioQarGain: Workbook gain: equity including cash minus total cost including cash. Cash P/L is zero.
source.sector: Each sector’s share of total equity (open lots + cash). Sector names come from Stock Master.
source.returnChart: Per-ticker workbook return: equity ÷ total cost − 1. Cash is shown at 0%.
source.allocation: Weight of each ticker’s equity in total equity including cash. Same basis as Weight %.
source.ticker: QSE symbol from the P&L transaction workbook, matched to Stock Master.
source.company: Company name from Stock Master for this ticker.
source.sectorCol: Sector on Stock Master for this ticker.
source.shares: Net open quantity after replaying buys, sells, and transfers through the as-of date.
source.costPrice: Weighted average cost of the remaining lot: remaining cost ÷ shares. Buy commissions stay in cost.
source.price: Official close on or before as-of. If none, last trade price in the P&L workbook.
source.weightPct: This row’s equity ÷ sum of all equity including cash.
source.holdingDays: Calendar days from buying date to as-of.
source.returnContribution: This row’s P/L ÷ sum of all holdings P/L.
source.annualizedReturn: Workbook annualized: (1 + return)^(holding days / 365) − 1. Not the CFA convention.
source.sectoralDis: That sector’s weight of total NAV (same as the sector pie).
source.dailyNav: NAV on that close: equity + cash.
source.dailyChgQar: Change in NAV versus the previous close, in QAR.
source.dailyChgPct: Change in NAV versus the previous close, in percent.
